svg.title: Media lifecycle and failure boundary
svg.desc: Runtime checks establish exact frames, clean exit, process reaping, group closure, and workspace removal; the public receipt records the bounded process facts. Explanatory branches summarize retry and escalation contracts plus failures outside graceful cleanup.
svg.text: FAILURE MODEL — clean branch runtime-verified; failure branches explanatory
18 full frames → EOF / exit 0 → process group quiescent → private workspaces removed
Receipt: stderr 0 B · leader reaped true · group closed true · termination none
invalid binding · startup/idle timeout · stderr cap · partial frame · caller cancellation
retain owned handles → request TERM ≤ 2s → KILL ≤ 2s if needed → reap → safe path-free error
Uncertain descriptor cleanup remains explicitly retryable; foreign replacement slots are not closed
Outside graceful cleanup: SIGKILL · os._exit · interpreter/native crash · kernel failure
No diagram branch claims detection, recognition, accuracy, throughput, or camera compatibility
